title: Add new release repositories
author: moriarty
body:
* Name of the release team: picknik

* Release repositories to add: ros2_robotiq_gripper-release

  * [ros2_robotiq_gripper](https://github.com/PickNikRobotics/ros2_robotiq_gripper)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry] https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/37857

I've just submitted the PR adding the source entry into rosdistro.
package names:
 - robotiq_controllers
 - robotiq_description
 - robotiq_driver
 
 @MarqRazz and I from PickNik #281 will be maintaining this release along with the picknik_controllers #284 
 And the Robotiq gripper is the default gripper for the Kinova arm #291
